title: Surreal Child Portrait
description: A surreal painted portrait of a young boy with a serious expression, his head dissolving into colorful dripping paint and dark smoke. The composition blends a vibrant pink melting castle on a green hill to the left, large pink and yellow peonies in the foreground, and a desolate ruined cityscape under a hazy sky to the right, with a smaller grayscale duplicate of the boy's face in the bottom right corner.
prompt: Surreal symbolic portrait of a young boy with a solemn gaze, his hair melting into vibrant red, green and yellow paint drips mixed with dark smoke. To the left a pink melting castle with dripping forms on a green hill, large pink and yellow peonies with red abstract shapes in the foreground. To the right a desolate ruined city under a sickly yellow sky, a smaller grayscale version of the same boy's face in the lower right corner, painterly style with visible brushwork and dripping effects.
